title: سعيت ولكن ما وصلت إلى المدى
author: Jamīl Ṣidqī al-Zahāwī
yearLabel: Published in 1327 AH (1909–10) · composition date not established here
context: Al-Zahāwī's 1327 AH title page says he omitted some verses from his poems, without identifying every affected work. This reading follows the 1909–10 printing; the linked 1924 printing has the same separately bounded couplet count. Matching boundaries establish the texts as printed, not independent descent or completeness in every tradition. Vowel marks are omitted, some spelling and spacing are normalized, and printed half-lines are on separate lines. Iraq is associated with the poet, not an asserted composition place; the composition date is not established here. Both printings separately head and bound five couplets. The 1909 reading has برغم من دلالة مرشدي and ما جمعنا وسائلا لمصلحة; the 1924 version reads برغم السعي والعلم والنهى and ما اتخذنا وسائلا لمنفعة.
sourceTitle: Internet Archive · Al-Kalim al-manẓūm (1327 AH), p. 155
rights: The historical original and pre-1931 printing are public domain in the United States. The scans are linked, not republished; check local law before reuse.
text:
سعيت ولكن ما وصلت إلى المدى
فلله أتعابي التي ذهبت سدى
بقيت برغم من دلالة مرشدي
بمنزلة بين الضلالة والهدى
كسبت من الأيام بعد تجاربي
يقينا بأن الأصدقاء هم العدى
لحى الله دهرا ما جمعنا وسائلا
لمصلحة إلا تصدى فأفسدا
وبعد ما بين الخصاصة والغنى
وقرب ما بين السلامة والردى

title: تقلب بانتظام في الهواء
author: Jamīl Ṣidqī al-Zahāwī
yearLabel: Published in 1327 AH (1909–10) · composition date not established here
context: Al-Zahāwī's 1327 AH title page says he omitted some verses from his poems, without identifying every affected work. This reading follows the 1909–10 printing; the linked 1924 printing has the same separately bounded couplet count. Matching boundaries establish the texts as printed, not independent descent or completeness in every tradition. Vowel marks are omitted, some spelling and spacing are normalized, and printed half-lines are on separate lines. Iraq is associated with the poet, not an asserted composition place; the composition date is not established here. The 1909 headnote introduces the description as appearing at the start of an al-Muqtaṭaf article; the 1924 book separately heads the same seven couplets. text:
تقلب بانتظام في الهواء
حمائم هن زينة كل راء
ملونة وليس هناك صبغ
بألوان حوت كل البهاء
حمائم كلما رمن اقترابا
من الأرض ارتفعن إلى السماء
وعدن صواعدا متقلبات
وليس صعودهن بلا عناء
هجرن وكونهن بها اضطرارا
فطرن من الصباح إلى المساء
إذا رمن الوقوع على بيوت
ربين بها انقلبن إلى الوراء
بتصفيق يلذ لسامعيه
وتصعيد ورقص في الهواء
